title: Penthouse Magazine July 2007 Tila Tequila Complete w/ Centerfold Slash Slayer
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no visible creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, July 2007 issue, original $7.99 cover price. Complete with centerfold (the magazine's first perforated centerfold).

Cover: Tila Tequila. Also: wisdom from Slash; advice from Fabolous; Sasha Grey photographed by Terry Richardson; Chuck Liddell, Jack White, Travis Pastrana and Slayer; headphones, head cases and secrets of barroom balling.

Back cover: Djarum clove cigarettes ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
